akiñcana.p:
[Na+kiñcana] (ti) CL=8 Not having a little - something - anything A) The Dhamma which is the left over of Paṭhamā-ruppavi wisdom (Tatiyāruppavi wisdom) B) Not having any wealth / possession - being poor - (the poor) C) The person who has no wealth / possessions which is saved or stored (the virtuous person)
Akiñcana(ti) [na+kiñcana] The person who has no anxiety / worries and the dhamma which can torture and disturb the mind A) The person who has no passion dhamma which can torture mind (Buddha, Arhat) B) The ending of the passion dhamma which can torture the mind (Nibanna)
